parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque OAuth state token built by SKU.io when generating the authorization URL. Contains the tenant identifier and the integration instance ID, e.g. `<tenant>_<integration_instance_id>`. Used to validate the callback origin and re-initialize tenancy.

parameters.name: spapi_oauth_code
parameters.description: Single-use authorization code issued by Amazon LWA. Exchanged server-side for a refresh + access token pair.

parameters.name: selling_partner_id
parameters.description: The Amazon Seller Central account identifier (merchant token) of the seller who completed the OAuth consent flow. Persisted onto the integration instance connection settings.
